paragraphs.text: AI Accelerate was a visual identity and learning experience created for an internal AI learning programme.

runs.text: AI Accelerate was a visual identity and learning experience created for an internal AI learning programme.

paragraphs.text: The brief was to create a distinctive visual language for a programme designed to help employees learn, apply and build confidence with AI. I was responsible for developing the visual direction from the ground up - beginning with the identity and logo, then extending the system into a family of character-led AI bots, level progression, supporting visuals and an editable dashboard that could be used to communicate the programme.

paragraphs.text: The challenge was to develop a complete visual system within a tight delivery window, starting with a new identity and extending it across seven levels of an AI learning programme. The system needed to include distinct AI characters, multiple poses, a clear progression mechanic and supporting assets, while remaining consistent, engaging and practical for a corporate audience. With limited time for exploration and iteration, the process required fast creative decisions, AI-assisted development and a strong focus on building a flexible system that could be carried through to an editable dashboard and reusable programme materials.

paragraphs.text: The final outcome was a complete and flexible visual system for AI Accelerate, built from a single identity into a full learning experience. The logo established the visual language, while the seven AI bots, individual poses, progression system and supporting assets created a consistent way to represent each stage of the programme. I also developed an editable dashboard and presentation system, giving the team a practical set of assets that could be updated and reused across the programme.

I worked on the concept and interactive experience for the Fungie touchscreen, developing the visual direction, interaction flow and interface design before building the experience in Intuiface.

paragraphs.text: I created a PowerPoint template deck containing multiple purpose-built layouts within the Master Slide system, allowing employees to duplicate a relevant slide and populate it with their own content. I also created dedicated reference slides covering fonts, colours, gradients and usage guidance, giving users a practical toolkit for creating additional content. The result was a flexible self-service system that made internal screen content easier to produce while keeping the brand consistently represented.

paragraphs.text: Intel's brand language is built around the idea of the Spark - a simple square element that represents where ideas and innovation begin. For a Christmas communication, the challenge was to connect this recognisable brand element with the warmth and visual language of the festive season.

runs.text: Intel's brand language is built around the idea of the
Spark

- a simple square element that represents where ideas and innovation begin. For a Christmas communication, the challenge was to connect this recognisable brand element with the warmth and visual language of the festive season.

paragraphs.text: I developed the concept by taking the Spark from a flat 2D element and turning it into a dimensional cube. From there, the cube became a visual representation of Intel's world, with three levels revealing different activities and moments within the building. As the structure rotates and snow begins to fall, the scene shifts from technology and innovation into a seasonal setting, eventually transforming the entire building into a wrapped Christmas present.

The idea needed to come from the brand itself rather than simply placing Christmas elements around an existing Intel visual.
